description: NVIDIA fell ~6.9% on 2025-04-16 after disclosing, in an Item 8.01 8-K, that the U.S. government now requires a license to export its H20 chips to China - and that Q1 FY2026 results would include up to ~$5.5B of related charges. A non-earnings catalyst: the explanatory text is a short regulatory disclosure in the 8-K body, with no press-release exhibit to lean on.

trigger.verified_fact: Close-to-close decline of ~6.9% on 2025-04-16, from $112.20 to $104.49.
trigger.note: Real daily closes from Yahoo Finance.

filing.note: Body-only filing - no exhibits. This is deliberately different in shape from the earnings fixtures, where the substance lives in EX-99 exhibits: here retrieval has to work against one short regulatory disclosure.

ground_truth.one_line: A U.S. export-license requirement for H20 chips to China, disclosed the prior evening, carrying up to ~$5.5B of charges in the current quarter.
key_facts_from_filing: On April 9, 2025 the U.S. government informed NVIDIA that exporting H20 integrated circuits to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries now requires a license.
On April 14, 2025 the U.S. government said the license requirement will be in effect for the indefinite future.
Q1 FY2026 results are expected to include up to approximately $5.5 billion of charges for H20 inventory, purchase commitments, and related reserves.
The stated rationale is the risk that covered products may be used in, or diverted to, a supercomputer in China.
ground_truth.key_facts_note: All four are stated directly in the 8-K body.
market_context: The disclosure landed during a broader drawdown in AI-hardware names.
China was widely understood to be a material share of data-center demand.
ground_truth.market_context_note: Not in the filing; excluded from the correctness score.
ground_truth.expected_citation: The 8-K body (body_8k). There are no exhibits in this filing.
ground_truth.naive_failure_mode: A system tuned to earnings language may retrieve poorly here, since the filing contains no revenue or margin figures - only a regulatory disclosure and a single charge estimate. Failing to connect an export restriction to a price decline, or reaching for unrelated earnings material, would both be wrong.

provenance.sources: Filing text read directly from EDGAR accession 0001045810-25-000082; daily closes from Yahoo Finance.
